title: Review: test coverage KITH-ngr5
notes: Round 10 review: 3 findings. Confidence: 85% chance of no missed bug. Finding 1 (P2, correctness): test comment claims the select! closed() arm fires, but the actual exit path is the is_closed() check in the empty-batch branch — the select! arm is never exercised in this test. Finding 2 (P2, correctness): the select! closed() arm has zero direct test coverage; a regression removing it would pass this test. Finding 3 (P3, risk): the receiver_count()==1 assertion after one yield_now() depends on undocumented single-threaded tokio scheduler ordering. The drop(resp) → live_tx.closed() chain is sound; axum Sse holds the stream directly in the response body so dropping resp does drop live_rx. The 5-yield count for the final assertion is adequate given the single-threaded runtime. No bikeshedding.
